summary: A comedy Bay-Area song made into a card: tap it and the standup-meeting anthem plays, camera off and mute on.
license_note: The song and its cover are the work; the card is a physical handle that points at where the song plays. The two card faces are exports of the cover art.
origin: Downstream of two generators in this network: its cover took plates from LEVIATHAN (card LEVIATHAN-010, https://persona500.com/leviathan) and PANGEA (card PANGEA-012, https://persona500.com/pangea), plus GO LOCO, a face, and Meta.
